thread_title: Interesting hybrids and back-crosses, Okaloosa Co, FL
breadcrumb: Interesting hybrids and back-crosses, Okaloosa Co, FL

posts.body_html:
This site wasn't particularly "crackin hard" this year for whatever reason, but in any case, we did find some really interesting varieties, forms, and hybrids. I'm now starting to believe that S. flava 'Killer' is either of a moorei back cross origin, or from mixing flava var. atropurpurea with something else:







Some mixed red forms:



this dark red veined plant was quite impressive:



Same plant: the body was solid red for the most part:


more pics to follow, with some habitat overview shots!
